text: ClickHouse, Inc.'s $350 million Series C (announced May 2025) was led by Khosla Ventures, with existing investor GIC — Singapore's sovereign wealth fund — among the participants, alongside Index Ventures, Lightspeed, Benchmark, Coatue, FirstMark and Nebius. This source does not mention any separate Dragoneer-led round, which would need its own source to verify.

source.name: ClickHouse: ClickHouse raises $350 million Series C to power analytics for the AI era
source.quote: The round was led by Khosla Ventures, with participation from new investors BOND, IVP, Battery Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, as well as existing investors including Index Ventures, Lightspeed, GIC
